config.generation_order: all pretest pools in repeat then role order; tests last in repeat order
config.proposal: uniform permutations; reject all previously occupied inverse/reverse/complement orbits
config.rng: numpy.PCG64(SeedSequence([data_seed, role_index, n])); test uses test_seed and role_index=4
config.target_order: accepted maximum pool reordered by PCG64(SeedSequence([subset_seed,n])).permutation(1024); nested prefixes
config.history: all archived DMLR permutation NPZs outside this experiment, including pilots, platform examples, task-count v1/v2, historical smoke pools and relation_readout_v1
config.capacity: floor(n!/8) minus all historically occupied n=10 orbits must cover every new pool including future tests
config.test_gate: 120 distinct frozen selections covering 8 units x 5 routes x 3 sizes; training_complete=true
config.pairing: all conditions share role-specific inputs within a unit; only task definitions/labels differ
config.sampling_limitations: finite permutation space; uniform permutation proposals followed by orbit rejection are not iid uniform surviving orbits; global exclusion conditions later pools on earlier acceptance
